whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Total Computer Solution,

I noticed your store has incredible 5.0★ ratings with nearly 1,900 reviews on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile catalog and instant part inquiry feature.

Maine aapke computer store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp hardware enquiry, RAM/SSD compatibility guide, aur store timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/totalcomputer

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Total Computer Solution) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp hardware inquiries and a clean mobile-first layout for your Boring Road store. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact inventory aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
